targets.title: Or7a condition: endpoint fluorescence and exploratory Test 1 control contrasts
targets.body_markdown:
### Endpoint microscopy

The fixed HEK293 image set contains **2 technical fields** labelled Or7a+ORCO, with **192 eligible DAPI objects**. At the blank-derived p99 cutoff, RED-positive objects were **21/192 (10.9%)**, GREEN-positive **3/192 (1.6%)**, and both-positive **1/192 (0.5%)**. Eligible objects represented 16.2% of DAPI foreground.

These are counts around resolvable nuclear objects, not whole-culture transfection efficiency or viability. The images were acquired around 44–48 h after transfection, before G418 selection, after 2% PFA fixation and DAPI staining without recorded permeabilization. Field counts are technical sampling, not biological replication. The images do not establish plasma-membrane localization, and their batch relationship to P2 is unresolved.

The first numbered field is shown to make the endpoint readout inspectable without selecting the brightest field. Brightfield and DAPI provide cellular context; the GREEN and RED channels ask whether localized fluorescence accompanies the reporter fusion and independent mCherry marker.

![Or7a+ORCO field 01, brightfield and separate BLUE/GREEN/RED channels](https://registry.igem.wiki/documentation/c09e424a-254d-42f7-9b0b-b8ba0e48659e/6ec5ffe3634ab0eb5c8b822125e5108daebea2b925807437400d7bf7ba1cffcb.avif)

*Or7a+ORCO, field 01, fixed-cell image panel. Display windows are BLUE 0–255, GREEN 0–120 and RED 0–180 digital values; brightfield retains exported levels. These display adjustments are not the quantitative input. The analysis uses the original channel TIFFs and the same blank-derived criteria across conditions. Compare the [untransfected field 01](https://static.igem.wiki/teams/6460/wiki/aerosense-assets-20261017/d7e6a0850fe4-field-01-panel.webp); the original 100 µm scale bars remain in the channel panels.*

| Blank-score cutoff | RED-positive objects | GREEN-positive objects |
|---|---:|---:|
| p95 | 45/192 (23.4%) | 18/192 (9.4%) |
| p99 | 21/192 (10.9%) | 3/192 (1.6%) |
| p99.5 | 20/192 (10.4%) | 3/192 (1.6%) |

*Counts across all available fields for this condition. p95, p99 and p99.5 are alternative blank-score cutoffs, not confidence levels or independent measurements. The denominator is unchanged across cutoffs.*

Most of the GREEN-positive count disappears between p95 and p99, while the three objects remaining at p99 also remain at p99.5. The RED marker is detectable in more eligible objects than the GREEN signal; the single dual-positive object does not establish a uniformly co-expressing culture.

### Test 1: paired-round fluorescence measurements

**Assay labels.** “Round 1” and “round 2” in the older plot are the buffer and test stages of **Test 1**, not separate tests. Its R/B/D table values are dimensionless (×100 gives percentage points). The later **[Test 2 characterization](#odor-2026-10-21)** below uses the same within the post-addition acquisition minus within the pre-addition acquisition calculation as the wiki, with S in percentage points.

One plate, one well per condition–stimulus combination; raw export headers span **10–11 October 2026**. R = ΔFtest − ΔFblank; B subtracts the same-condition buffer-only well; D additionally subtracts the same-stimulus untransfected-minus-buffer contrast. Full equations, denominators, provenance and exclusions are in [the collection](https://registry.igem.org/collections/40067138-a3dd-4e5b-b8a4-50b097ee0156).

| Well | Addition | ΔFblank | ΔFtest | R | B | D |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| A01 | VUAA1 | +0.0102 | -0.0447 | -0.0549 | -0.0243 | -0.0833 |
| D01 | 3-octanol | -0.0032 | +0.0929 | +0.0961 | +0.1268 | +0.0443 |
| E01 | benzaldehyde | -0.0706 | +0.0495 | +0.1201 | +0.1508 | +0.0213 |
| F01 | 2-heptanone | -0.1637 | +0.0198 | +0.1835 | +0.2141 | +0.1176 |
| G01 | valeric acid | +0.0395 | +0.0119 | -0.0276 | +0.0031 | -0.0415 |
| H01 | buffer only | -0.0530 | -0.0836 | -0.0307 | +0.0000 | +0.0000 |

B and D for the buffer row are zero by construction. Rows B (ethyl propionate) and C (isopentyl acetate) are excluded from retained comparisons because of reported gain changes; their raw data remain in the archive. Nominal VUAA1 final concentration is 50 µM in the source report, not independently verified. Final VOC molarity, numeric detector gain and matched DMSO vehicle concentration remain unresolved.

![Or7a: two sequential measurement rounds](https://registry.igem.wiki/documentation/c09e424a-254d-42f7-9b0b-b8ba0e48659e/f8796e32ee49019bec0735924d7700b83fcc00b16d8079259179ce351afc4483.avif)

*Test 1 paired-round plot: plain assay buffer in round 1, test addition in round 2, each normalized to its own baseline. These are two stages of Test 1, not Test 1 versus Test 2. Plain buffer is not a documented DMSO-matched vehicle. The plot shows both individual rounds; the table supplies R and the between-well B and D contrasts.*
